info.cls_ename: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

description.describe_ch: 以工程技術的觀點瞭解材料製程如何影響金屬材料顯微組織、以物理科學的觀點探討金屬材料顯微組織(結構)與機械性質相關聯的理論基礎，並研究在工業應用上對於各種技術問題的改進方法。主要闡述金屬材料強化機制，內容包括：退火、固溶體、析出硬化、置換型固溶體之擴散、插入型固溶體之擴散、金屬的固化、孕核及成長動力學。
description.describe_eh: Understand how the material manufacturing processes affect the microstructure of metal materials from the perspective of engineering technology, explore the theoretical basis of the relationship between the microstructure and mechanical properties of metal materials from the perspective of physical science, and study the effects of various technical issues in industrial applications. This course will explain the strengthening mechanisms of metal materials, including: annealing, solid solutions, precipitation hardening, diffusion in substitution solid solutions, interstitial diffusion of inserted solid solution, solidification of metals, nucleation and growth kinetics.

targets.describe_ch: 說明與定義退火的完整理論，並針對退火的三個部分詳細分析其機構，並瞭解固溶原理以及固溶的條件，和其相關理論。
targets.describe_en: Explain and define the intact anneals and solid solution and analyze the organization in detail to three parts of annealing; and indication for the principle of solid solution condition, and its relevant theory firmly .

targets.describe_ch: 理解並解釋基本相圖，定義其基本相圖，以及相平衡的觀念。
targets.describe_en: Comprehends and explain the basic phases diagram, and its idea of phases equilibrium.

targets.describe_ch: 分析擴散的機制與原理，並比較置換型固溶體與格隙原子擴散的行為。
targets.describe_en: Analysis for the mechanism and principle of the diffusion, and compare the diffusion behaviors of substitutional and interstitial. solid solution.

targets.describe_ch: 闡釋金屬固體的固化過程及其機構並判斷孕核成長的理論，以及其動力學、熱力學性質、與驅動力。
targets.describe_en: Interpretation for solidification process and its mechamism and judge the theory of nucleation and growth, and its kinetics process, thermodynamics properties, and driving force.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. 考評及補考
    應參加考試之學生，未遵守請假或請假未經核准，而未參加考試者，該科該次考試成績以零分計算。
  2. 作弊及抄襲
    • 違反此規則者，該次評核“不計分”或課程“不計分”。

Comprehensive description

  3.
